option.label: Sheath bristles arise from small raised bases
option.detail: Gould calls sheaths pustulate-hispid. Inspect hairs and raised bases on the sheath, not the blade or a flowering glume. Diggs confirms long papilla-based sheath hairs.

option.label: Fringed membrane 1.5–3 mm INCLUDING hairs
option.detail: Measure the whole ligule including its fringe. This is not a1.5–3mm membrane-height interval. Gould says commonly; Diggs gives ca.1–3mm including hairs.

option.label: Panicle branches never strongly spreading
option.detail: Gould account: more-or-less contracted, usually somewhat drooping panicle, short-pedicelled crowded spikelets at branchlets/tips. Preserve broader cultivar silhouettes in existing sources.

option.label: Branch axils hairless, without pulvini
option.detail: Inspect the PANICLE branch axils for hair tufts and swollen joint pads. This does not establish absence of a medial groove on a branch or pedicel.

option.label: LOWER glume has five veins
option.detail: Identify the first outer glume, then count five nerves. Do not apply this count to the upper glume or a lemma.

option.label: UPPER glume usually nine veins (7–11)
option.detail: Gould gives second glume9-(7–11)-nerved. Record the upper glume separately from lower lemma, which has the same reported vein range.

option.label: LOWER glume half to three-quarters as long
option.detail: Compare first glume with second glume and lower lemma; Gould gives length1/2–3/4, acute/acuminate apex. This is not a minute/missing first glume.

option.label: LOWER lemma usually nine veins (7–11)
option.detail: The lower floret lemma is thin and strongly nerved, usually9 (7–11). Separate it from both outer glumes and the smooth shiny upper fertile lemma.

option.label: UPPER lemma smooth/shiny, yellowish to reddish-brown
option.detail: Gould gives upper floret lemma3–3.5mm, smooth/shiny and yellowish to reddish-brown. Existing firm/shiny genus evidence remains separate.
